Reason codes carried by insight observations (reason_code, potential_reason) and detector evaluations (suppressed_by_reason keys). The 12 codes of INS backlog §3 plus codes required by the detector registry. MISSING_CAPABILITY is parametric: MISSING_CAPABILITY:<capability_key> with keys from data/contracts/insights/source_projection_request.v1.yaml capability_keys.
title: InsightReasonCode

x-bridge-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: Fewer complete observations than the detector requires (eligible_on is reported when predictable).
x-bridge-descriptions.INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: The window has incomplete units (hours/days/snapshots) for a required input.
x-bridge-descriptions.ADAPTIVE_UNSUPPORTED: Adaptive warehouse: classic idle/attribution metrics do not apply.
x-bridge-descriptions.CURRENCY_INCOMPATIBLE: Inputs carry different currencies or no single rate basis; values are never converted.
x-bridge-descriptions.BELOW_IMPACT_FLOOR: impact_amount_30d is not strictly greater than insights.impact_floor_30d for the currency.
x-bridge-descriptions.ATTRIBUTION_COVERAGE: executions with a QAH row / executions < q01.min_attribution_coverage in a cohort.
x-bridge-descriptions.WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_CHANGED: Dominant identity tuple changed or fell below q02.identity_dominance.
x-bridge-descriptions.CALIBRATION_FAILED: Modeled credits deviate from metered credits by more than wh02.calibration_max_rel_error.
x-bridge-descriptions.NOT_ACTIONABLE_DROPPED: The table is dropped; bytes are shown in the storage view, not as an insight.
x-bridge-descriptions.SHARED_OR_EXTERNAL_READERS_POSSIBLE: Readers outside connected accounts are possible (outbound share, replication, external/Iceberg).
x-bridge-descriptions.EQUAL_AT_THRESHOLD: The value equals a strict threshold; equality never qualifies.
x-bridge-descriptions.PREDICATE_NOT_MET: Evaluated with complete inputs; the predicate is false.
x-bridge-descriptions.ZERO_DENOMINATOR: A ratio denominator is zero or unknown.
x-bridge-descriptions.NO_PRICE: No effective rate for the inputs (FIN-002/FIN-006); money is null, never 0.
x-bridge-descriptions.UNKNOWN_CREDIT_RATE: Warehouse size/type/generation has no verified credits-per-hour entry (config/warehouse_credit_rates.v1.json).
x-bridge-descriptions.HASH_VERSION_CHANGED: QUERY_PARAMETERIZED_HASH_VERSION differs between cohorts; families are never compared across versions.
x-bridge-descriptions.BRIDGE_OVERHEAD_EXCLUDED: Bridge's own extraction workload (QUERY_TAG bridge_finops:*) is never an optimization target.
x-bridge-descriptions.GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED: A guardrail detector (queueing, spill) blocks the recommendation.
x-bridge-descriptions.ZERO_COST_HEADROOM: Configured headroom that is never billed (unused maximum clusters).
x-bridge-descriptions.ALIAS_OF_OTHER_DETECTOR: The id is a filter alias of another detector (WH04 → WH01 HIGH tier).
x-bridge-descriptions.NOT_APPLICABLE_SOURCE: The resource kind is not eligible for the detector (e.g. Snowpipe Streaming for PI01).
x-bridge-descriptions.PRICING_ARCHITECTURE_CHANGED: Window predates a pricing architecture change (Snowpipe per-GB pricing 2025-12-08).
x-bridge-descriptions.SOURCE_RETIRED: The input source was retired by the authority layer inside the window.
x-bridge-descriptions.DETECTOR_DISABLED: Detector disabled for the tenant (workflow.detector_tenant_setting) or not yet qualified (INS-105 gate).
x-bridge-descriptions.NOT_ESTIMABLE_BY_DESIGN: potential_reason only: impact kind CEILING/EXPOSURE/OBSERVED_EXCESS/NONE carries no numeric potential.
x-bridge-descriptions.TRIAL_ACCOUNT: Snowflake trial account: demonstration only (D-35); observations are labelled and excluded from portfolio totals.
